title: Hermes Telegram Mini App

lines: Run your Hermes agent from Telegram

shots.caption: Ask from your phone. Hermes answers in your Telegram chat.

ask.question: Three-bullet checklist before I ship a release tonight? No commands.
ask.skip_chip: Skipped: the wait for Hermes's next tick
ask.delivered_note: Hermes's real reply, as Telegram shows it

voice.text: Ask your agent anything from your phone. It runs once, on your real Hermes.
Seconds later, the answer lands in your Telegram chat.

shots.caption: Live from a real Hermes v{hermes_version}: host, sessions and cron.

voice.text: Live status at a glance: host load, sessions and cron jobs.

shots.caption: Run, pause and edit cron jobs. Failed runs are flagged.

voice.text: Pause, resume, run now, or edit any cron job. If a run fails, you'll see it.

shots.caption: Read what your agent did, step by step.

voice.text: And you can read exactly what your agent did.

shots.caption: Browse skills. English and Malay built in.

voice.text: Skills are searchable, in English or Malay.

lines: Built to be safe on a phone

voice.text: Login is verified by Telegram. No VPN, no password.
